payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE (commit 790f32b): opt-in StreamStore.pruneRetention(policies) — maxAgeMs + maxEvents per stream type, keep-forever default, FrickStore timer armed only when a policy is set. Correlated maxEvents DELETE verified identical on SQLite + real Postgres. Cursor-safety documented as operator responsibility. 4 tests; suite 788 green.
